facts.fact: The GPE Independent Technical Advisory Panel says the EMIS is not yet integrated with other education management infrastructure and data sources, including human resources management and examinations.
The Panel says the ministry of education is developing a human resources module to be integrated in the education management information system; no completion is stated.
